Behind the image
13 / Cherry Red
REFERENCE 5032.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 014
Art direction: Playful retro beauty editorial, soft frontal light and graphic color blocking.
Photorealistic vertical close-up studio portrait of an original adult East Asian woman with a straight
black fringe, a glossy cherry-red headband, symmetrical features, a direct playful gaze and glossy
red lips. She wears a red top with sculpted puff sleeves. Pale pink seamless backdrop, soft frontal
light, graphic red color blocking, retro beauty editorial, clean skin detail, no text or logos.
14 / Monochrome Line
REFERENCE 5031.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 014
Art direction: Clean black-and-white styling, crisp studio light and full-length framing.
Full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman standing straight and
facing the camera, long straight glossy black hair with a center part falling past the shoulders,
calm neutral expression and direct gaze. She wears a fitted black ribbed-knit turtleneck with long
sleeves, a clean white A-line mini skirt, white ribbed knee-high socks and pointed black patent
flats. Arms relaxed at her sides, slightly elongated model pose, pure white seamless studio
background, soft even frontal lighting with minimal shadows, crisp fabric and rib-knit texture,
strict black and white palette with natural skin tones, minimalist contemporary e-commerce
editorial style, sharp focus from head to toe, no text, logos or props.
